cases.note: A child is issued only from an active parent plus an explicit capability.delegate grant and a narrower contract.
Capability, selector, risk, validity, and budget broadening all fail closed.
A non-delegation grant and child subject equal to the delegator cannot create authority.
The global depth ceiling and per-contract depth limit are both enforced.
Child charges remain within allocation and sibling reservations cannot exceed parent headroom.
A valid child uses the existing policy decision boundary and the budget charge denies the second request after allocation is consumed.
Delegation cannot drop parent conditions, and invalid child construction leaves no partial root reservation.

known_limitations: Grant revisions, reservation audit records, and durable budget persistence are not implemented in G3.
Cross-workspace grant plus target mount acceptance is a later G4 boundary.
This fixture is executable evidence for the slice, not a TRUSTED qualification bundle.
